card.name: Start of methylene blue and antidote terms
card.fires_on: The first piece of "methylene" ("meth") in methylene blue, mostly in methemoglobinemia treatment text. Also the "avenous" part of "intravenous" and "carbon" before monoxide.

modes.label: Methylene blue start
modes.description: The "meth" opening of methylene blue as the treatment for methemoglobinemia.
modes.example: Methemoglobinemia over 30% should be treated with<< meth>>ylene blue by slow intravenous administration.

modes.label: Inside intravenous
modes.description: The "avenous" ending of "intravenous" before a named treatment such as sodium bicarbonate.
modes.example: Intr<<avenous>> sodium bicarbonate should be used to maintain

modes.label: Carbon before monoxide
modes.description: The word carbon in carbon monoxide, in lung test text.
modes.example: diffusion lung capacity for<< carbon>> monoxide (DLCO) were observed
